reserved_hosts.T4: User reports another workload; no experiment launch until availability established

small_integration.purpose: Actual public-data tools over persistent verified TLS; correctness only
small_integration.matched_netshaper_status: pending; current T4 reservation excludes original four-host topology

workload.scope: One-round natural-language reference bank; not a validated LLM/adaptive acquisition
workload.test_policy: Generate references without executing or tuning on final-test sessions
workload.site_policy: Partition each source row once; logical federation; no duplicated records
workload.size_policy: Measure actual matching rows on calibration split; do not manufacture manuscript buckets
workload.confirmatory_suitability: Not locked: audit class support and cohort shift using train/select first

privacy_accounting.adjacency: Bounded-pair protected executions, L1 directional volume difference <= 2V; adaptive full-session accounting
privacy_accounting.cap_constraint: Enforced V and Delta >= 2V after any size padding
privacy_accounting.accounting: epsilon_session = d * epsilon_direction; report epsilon_tick for queue mechanism separately
privacy_accounting.certification: Analytical accounting only; OS/TLS/wire-level DP not certified
privacy_accounting.netshaper: Record Gaussian epsilon/delta/adjacency/window/sensitivity; numerical epsilon alone is not comparability

primary_comparison.outcome: Max clipped test advantage over prespecified attackers and secrets versus paired measured extra joules per physical node
primary_comparison.contrast: Frozen controller versus best feasible frozen single primitive at the same prespecified mean per-node energy budgets
primary_comparison.budget_scope: Expected/mean energy, not a hard per-session cap
primary_comparison.inference: Paired bootstrap clustered by independently acquired question/run; training seeds are not acquisition replicates
primary_comparison.negative_result_policy: Retain no gain, best single selected, infeasible budgets and negative paired energy differences

measurement_policy.repetitions: >=10 independent acquisitions per energy condition under current protocol
measurement_policy.latency: Record planning, actual tool completion, answer completion and capture/cover horizon separately
measurement_policy.invalid_trial: Keep raw logs and reason; never silently discard timeout, overflow, cap exceedance, OOM or checksum failure
measurement_policy.concurrency: No concurrent competing CPU, disk or network measurements on participating hosts
measurement_policy.resource_screen: Bounded samples before, during and after; idle screen is not exclusive-use proof

large_run_gates: Public-workload class support and utility validated on train/select
Natural-language planner and second-model provenance validated; no hidden fallback
Correct distributed shaping and matched NetShaper captures with equal observer topology
Participating hosts available throughout paired acquisition
Readable calibrated energy sensors with declared physical scope for any energy claims
Energy model held-out relative RMSE <=0.2 or prospectively revised gate
Retained grid, feasible singles, budgets and attackers frozen before fresh final-test acquisition
